description:
List the bulk lead SOURCES this account may use — the live answer from the server's adapter registry, which is exactly what submit_bulk_lead_sourcing and estimate_bulk_lead_sourcing are validated against. CALL THIS BEFORE CHOOSING A provider. Reads only; spends nothing.

Per source:
  provider          the name to send as `provider`
  label, description  what to call it when you talk to the user
  source_kinds      the source_kind values it accepts
  available         false = listed but not usable on this deployment yet (unavailable_reason says why)
  requires_upload   true = it needs a records FILE, which the MCP bulk tools cannot send — use the dashboard for it
  source_is_free    true = nothing is bought at the source
  eligible_stages   the enrichment stages its records may run; a stage outside this list is a 422 on estimate and submit
  vocabulary        see below

VOCABULARY. null = free text: search terms and place labels you write yourself. Present = a CATALOGUE source: its queries MUST be values from vocabulary.query_options and its geo labels values from vocabulary.geo_options. Send each option's `value`, show the user its `label`, and never invent a value or infer one from the user's wording — pick from the list, or ask. The block also carries the source's own nouns (record_noun, expansion_noun — use them instead of "records" / "searches"). records_per_query_default is the DASHBOARD's prefill only: omitting max_records_per_query on submit still buys the platform default, so always send it.

A source that is NOT offered to this account is OMITTED from this list, not greyed out. Its absence is the answer — not a permission error to report, and not something a retry changes.

MONEY: source_is_free=true is the only thing that licenses the word "free", and it means free at the SOURCE. The downstream enrichment (leads x enabled stages) still spends.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: list_bulk_sources
